name: ai-setup
description: Personal Claude Code setup mirrored from OpenCode global configuration.

plugins.name: repo-docs
plugins.description: Local semantic doc search and installed-package lookup for one repository, plus the CodeGraph code-graph MCP server. Shared MCP servers; dev-core and orchestrate both require it.

plugins.name: dev-core
plugins.description: The always-on engineering rules, core skills, and the tier and domain specialist agents. Requires the repo-docs plugin for repo grounding.

plugins.name: concise-output
plugins.description: Always-on rules for how output reads: short and plain in anything a person sees, and only what was asked for in anything that leaves the machine.

plugins.name: rules-index
plugins.description: SessionStart reminder listing every .claude/rules and ~/.claude/rules file with its name, description, and paths, so path-scoped rules are known before a matching file is read.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Markdown-tracked orchestration with precomputed per-scope predicates, conditional solution-reuse research, separated standards/quality/correctness/implementation gates, and a local git-ignored store. Requires the repo-docs plugin.

plugins.name: orchestrate-nightly
plugins.description: Experimental fork of orchestrate: build-only workers on the cheapest adequate model, one batched reviewer per two chunks, cheap fixer. Explicit-trigger only; requires orchestrate.
